affected_boundaries: ordinary local command to foreign project state

observed_behavior: ponytail update-permissions in one repository failed when an unrelated registered repository had uncommitted project configuration.
expected_behavior: An ordinary local command or skill derives project-specific behavior only from the invoking project; project rules never enter user-global or foreign-project policy.
causal_mechanism: Permission compilation aggregated project contributions into one global policy, while reference QA assembled its identity catalog from all registered projects.

anti_pattern.structural_description: A local command consumes or projects configuration derived from multiple independently managed projects.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: A foreign project's configuration, registration, or accepted state changes another project's behavior.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: Project-derived inputs remain in project-keyed state and the invoking project's local configuration layer.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Separate global user policy from project policy, project each accepted proposal locally, and pass no implicit foreign catalog to ordinary local QA.

applicability_conditions: A user tool manages multiple independently configured projects.
An ordinary operation runs inside one project.
known_non_matches: An explicit repository-inventory validation command whose contract is to validate every registered project.
confirmation_evidence: Before the repair, the focused regression observed accepted-state V1 aggregation and blessed-worktree selection.
After the repair, global policy has no project source, project projections are disjoint, and local QA receives no foreign registry catalog.
regression_proofs: tests/ponytail-cli.test.js: update-permissions isolates every project policy from every other project
tests/ponytail-cli.test.js: update-permissions reads policy from the invoking worktree instead of the blessed worktree
tests/condense-codex-rules.test.js: keeps project policies in separate project-local projections
tests/project-validation.test.js: reference QA does not derive identities from another registered project
